entries.message: Feature - Add discovery and private media collections
entries.author: Lasikiewicz
details: Browse cached TMDB discovery rails with type and genre filters and direct title actions.
Save movies, shows, and episodes to a private watchlist or rate them without changing canonical watch history.
Show every custom list as its own horizontal media rail, with four fixed desktop rows and additional lists below.
Keep custom-list wheel scrolling predictable by waiting for a stationary pointer and preserving page scrolling at rail boundaries.
